Home.factsTitle: Two decades devoted to a single detail.
Home.factsBody: Zhongshan Uten Electrical Co., Ltd. integrates R&D, manufacturing and sales. Since its first in-house tooling programme in 2007, the company has built a 30,000 m² modern production base, with ISO 9001 quality system and CCC certified products, and a Hong Kong team for global affairs — supporting international customers with product selection and OEM / ODM cooperation.

Capabilities.title: From a market brief to a product decision.
Capabilities.subtitle: Uten supports international distributors, project teams and private-label buyers with product selection, development coordination and model-specific document review.
Capabilities.introTitle: Clear evidence for every product decision.
Capabilities.introBody: We organise the review around the target standard, electrical rating, finish, dimensions and compliance evidence for the exact model before quotation or approval.
Capabilities.developmentBody: Start with the design series, required functions, gang count, control mode and installation constraints. We help turn the brief into a reviewable product shortlist.
Capabilities.manufacturingBody: Sample, material, finish, marking, packaging and production requirements are reviewed as one project scope. Custom work proceeds only after feasibility and specification confirmation.
Capabilities.qualityBody: Archived company material documents switch and socket life testing, high-voltage testing, flame-resistance checks, electronic-environment checks and laboratory work. Current scope varies by model and must be supported by current evidence.
Capabilities.documentsBody: Buyers can request current data sheets, dimensional information, installation instructions and applicable certificates or declarations for the exact model being evaluated.
Capabilities.archiveCaption: Uten company archive · laboratory and production records
Capabilities.evidenceNote: Archive photographs establish historical activity, not current certification for every product. Ask for model-specific, current documents.
Capabilities.workflowTitle: Five steps before a confident approval
Capabilities.step1Body: Country or region, building type, installation system and required standard.
Capabilities.step2Body: Design family, functions, gang count, finish and compatibility requirements.
Capabilities.step3Body: Confirm available models, custom scope, sample plan and open technical questions.
Capabilities.step4Body: Review samples, dimensions, ratings and applicable product documents.
Capabilities.step5Body: Agree the approved specification, packaging, quantity, schedule and change control.
Capabilities.ctaTitle: Bring us a market brief, not just a product photo.
Capabilities.ctaBody: The more clearly you describe the target market and approval requirements, the more useful our response can be.

Partners.title: Build the right cooperation model around the project.
Partners.subtitle: Distribution, project sourcing and OEM / ODM enquiries need different information. A structured brief helps our team review each request by market, customer type and product requirement.
Partners.modelsTitle: Choose the conversation that fits your role
Partners.distributionBody: Discuss target territory, channel profile, range selection, samples, marketing materials and ongoing product support.
Partners.projectBody: Share the building type, target standard, schedule, quantities and required documents for product selection and review.
Partners.oemBody: Submit the product scope, design intent, technical requirements, branding, packaging and expected volume for a feasibility review.
Partners.designBody: Coordinate finishes, wall-box compatibility, functions, samples and installation information before specification.
Partners.briefBody: No fixed MOQ, delivery time or certification is claimed across the entire catalogue. These are confirmed against the requested model and project.
Partners.briefDocuments: Required data sheets, drawings or compliance documents
Partners.formTitle: Tell us about your market and project
Partners.formBody: Use the structured fields below so the right team can review your request without guessing.

Resources.title: Information that helps a product move from interest to approval.
Resources.subtitle: Use the guides below to prepare a clear brief, compare a series and request the right model-specific evidence.
Resources.guidesTitle: Start with the decisions that matter
Resources.documentsTitle: Ask for the current file for the exact model
Resources.documentsBody: The website does not treat one certificate, drawing or specification as applicable to every product. Tell us the model, target market and document purpose so the team can confirm what is current and applicable.
Resources.documentsList: Data sheet · dimensional drawing · installation instructions · applicable certificate or declaration · finish sample · packaging information
Resources.faq1a: No. This is a product and company information website. Contact Uten for selection support, samples, project review or commercial enquiries.
Resources.faq2a: Yes. Uten welcomes OEM / ODM enquiries. Each request is reviewed for product feasibility, specifications, branding, packaging, quantity and schedule.
Resources.faq3q: Are all products available in every country?
Resources.faq3a: No such assumption should be made. Availability, installation systems, standards and documents must be confirmed for the destination market and exact model.
Resources.faq4q: Can I request samples and finishes?
Resources.faq4a: Yes, subject to availability and project review. Physical samples take precedence over colours shown on a screen.
Resources.faq5q: Can I download certificates from the website?
Resources.faq5a: Only current, model-specific documents should be used for approval. Request the relevant file from Uten until a verified download library is published.
Resources.faq6q: What should an initial enquiry include?
Resources.faq6a: Include the target market, customer type, installation standard, product functions, estimated quantity, schedule and required documents.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice for website enquiries
Privacy.intro: This notice explains how contact details submitted through Uten's public website are used to respond to an enquiry.
Privacy.controllerBody: Zhongshan Uten Electrical Co., Ltd. receives website enquiries. Use the contact email on this page for privacy-related requests.
Privacy.dataBody: The form may collect your name, company, phone or email, target market, customer type, product interest, project requirements and technical metadata needed to protect the service.
Privacy.purposeBody: The information is used to review and respond to the requested product, project, partnership or support enquiry and to keep a business follow-up record.
Privacy.sharingBody: Access should be limited to personnel who need the information to respond. Hosting and technical providers may process information on Uten's behalf where required to operate the service.
Privacy.retentionBody: Enquiry records should be kept only as long as reasonably necessary for follow-up and applicable record-keeping obligations, then deleted or anonymised under company policy.
Privacy.rightsBody: You may contact Uten to ask about, correct or request deletion of information submitted through the form, subject to applicable legal and record-keeping requirements.
Privacy.reviewNote: If your enquiry involves additional market-specific privacy requirements, include them in your message or contact Uten before sharing sensitive information.
